record.title: DfCM current frontier
record.body: R61 remains canonical receipt-assimilation substrate on marketplace main 36fcc8e41dcbd01a3b10574eb1d029c1712fa3c1. Fresh containment now adds ex4pm main e2e36755f87c9a5297ed1d2727929f6a7031caf2 and GymAct main f3457bdb8a7878946783d34f402b95774eaf8c4b as independent R58 consumer evidence roots. Reachable frontier, in dependency order: (1) assimilate exact ex4pm and GymAct returned receipts into R61; (2) calculate evidence-root independence/common-cause discount on current heads; (3) measure request->execution->receipt->ALIVE->dependency-relief conversion and latency; (4) rebase/reconstitute R54 independence measurement on current marketplace main rather than old lineage; (5) manufacture additional target-local consumers from canonical R57 adapter only after exact candidate admission; (6) feed measured relief into EXPLORE. Weakest multiplier is still independent consumer breadth plus causal downstream relief. 1000X remains NOT_ADMITTED.
